metadata.question: Was the sulfer dioxide concentration higher over Cumbre Vieja than the Funchal Island on October 18, 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need to compare SO2 concentrations at two locations on October 18, 2021 - Cumbre Vieja: volcanic region in La Palma, Canary Islands (~28.57°N, 17.84°W) - Funchal: city/island in Madeira, Portugal (~32.65°N, 16.91°W) - Use Sentinel-5P TROPOMI SO2 data (COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_SO2) - Single day: 2021-10-18 2. Masking strategy: - SO2 data quality should be checked using qa_value band - Filter for qa_value > 0.5 for reliable measurements - No cloud masking needed for atmospheric gas data 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: SO2 column density can legitimately be near 0 or low values (background levels) - Check if images exist (C1) - Check if valid pixels exist after QA filtering (C2) - Check if results are None/NaN (C3) - Compare: if Cumbre Vieja SO2 > Funchal SO2, answer A; otherwise B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const cumbreVieja = ee.Geometry.Point([-17.84, 28.57]); const funchal = ee.Geometry.Point([-16.91, 32.65]); const date = '2021-10-18'; // 2. Data Acquisition & Check const so2Collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_SO2') .filterDate(date, '2021-10-19') .select('SO2_column_number_density'); const collectionSize = await so2Collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Total SO2 images on ${date}: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log('No Sentinel-5P SO2 data available for this date.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Processing - Get mean SO2 for each location const so2Image = so2Collection.mean(); // Check valid pixels at Cumbre Vieja const cumbreCount = await so2Image.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: cumbreVieja, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('SO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); // Check valid pixels at Funchal const funchalCount = await so2Image.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: funchal, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('SO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels - Cumbre Vieja: ${cumbreCount}, Funchal: ${funchalCount}`); if (cumbreCount === 0 || funchalCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 4. Calculation - Get SO2 values const cumbreSO2 = await so2Image.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: cumbreVieja, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('SO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); const funchalSO2 = await so2Image.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: funchal, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('SO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (cumbreSO2 === null || funchalSO2 === null || isNaN(cumbreSO2) || isNaN(funchalSO2)) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid results.'); console.log('C3'); return; } console.log(`Cumbre Vieja SO2: ${cumbreSO2.toExponential(3)} mol/m²`); console.log(`Funchal SO2: ${funchalSO2.toExponential(3)} mol/m²`); console.log(`Difference: ${(cumbreSO2 - funchalSO2).toExponential(3)} mol/m²`); if (cumbreSO2 > funchalSO2) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
